question: Avani Lekhara is associated with which of the following sports?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Paralympic Shooting**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Avani Lekhara is associated with Paralympic shooting: 
 
• Achievements
 
• Avani Lekhara is an Indian rifle shooter who won two gold medals in the 10m rifle event at the 2020 and 2024 Paralympics.
 
• She is the first Indian woman to win two gold medals at the Paralympics. 
 
• Avani was initially drawn to archery, but transitioned to shooting in 2015 after being inspired by Abhinav Bindra.<
